briefdescription.para: Creates an ONNX text parser from a null-terminated buffer.
Parses an ONNX text snippet into the requested protobuf type.
High-level ONNX text-format parser that builds protobuf structures.

detaileddescription.para: Inherits from ParserBase and provides overloaded Parse() methods for every major ONNX protobuf type (ModelProto, GraphProto, FunctionProto, NodeProto, TensorProto, TypeProto, AttributeProto, etc.).
The most convenient entry point is the static Parse() helper: ModelProtomodel; autostatus=OnnxParser::Parse(model,text_buffer);
